Convert zone-ratio and zone-offset parameters to per-zone values

Source: R/zone_ratio.R
expand_zone_ratios.Rd

Expands the anchor + ratio parameterisation created by zone_ratio_param() (or the anchor + offset one from zone_offset_param()) into ordinary per-zone parameter rows that can be written to the model configuration. The ratio or offset rows are removed and replaced with one row per shallower zone, with value[i] = value[i - 1] * ratio[i] or value[i] = value[i - 1] + offset[i].

Usage

expand_zone_ratios(param)

Arguments

param

data.frame of parameters, with the columns of parameters().

Value

data.frame of parameters with the same columns as param and no zone-ratio or zone-offset rows.

Details

input_model_parameters() calls this itself, so parameters with zone-ratio rows can be passed straight to it, to run_aeme_ensemble(), or to any function that writes parameters to the model. Call it directly to see the per-zone values.

A param without any zone-ratio or zone-offset rows is returned unchanged.

See also

zone_ratio_param(), zone_offset_param()

Examples

p <- data.frame(model = "glm_aed", file = "aed.nml",
                name = "aed_sed_const2d/fsed_oxy", value = -30, min = -60,
                max = -5, group = NA_character_, index = 1)
p <- zone_ratio_param(p, n_zones = 3)
expand_zone_ratios(p)
#>     model    file                     name value min max group index
#> 1 glm_aed aed.nml aed_sed_const2d/fsed_oxy -30.0 -60  -5  <NA>     1
#> 2 glm_aed aed.nml aed_sed_const2d/fsed_oxy -15.0 -60  -5  <NA>     2
#> 3 glm_aed aed.nml aed_sed_const2d/fsed_oxy  -7.5 -60  -5  <NA>     3
